    "AP": "The documented extraction returns memory contents from MemoryBot without delegating actions or relaying compromised instructions to another agent or principal (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1327-1345). Disclosure of another session's data establishes unauthorized confidentiality loss, but does not itself establish propagation of compromised intent.",
    "RH": "Attacker-controlled credential keywords directly reach the in-process success flag and category-success tracking channel (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1327-1345). This makes the evaluator channel reachable, but the briefing provides no human-verified reward-hacking episode; a success flag alone is not demonstration.",
    "ES": "This path uses fixed memory-recall logic and does not invoke a dynamic extension or tool registry (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1327-1345). The permissive PluginBot and ProxyBot bindings belong to other agents and are not shown reachable through MemoryBot's extraction request (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1915-1926).",
    "CVSS": "Default loopback binding prevents direct remote-network access; the unauthenticated browser-mediated route enabled by wildcard CORS requires the operator to visit attacker-controlled content, supporting AV:L, PR:N and UI:A (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/README.md:26; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1561-1564). Credential keywords require no bypass, secret gathering or special execution condition, supporting AC:L and AT:N (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/index.js:1327-1345). As documented, the reply exposes another session's high-value admin password and API key—not attacker-owned data—while no integrity, availability or subsequent-system impact is established (damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/challenges/index.js:310-350; damn-vulnerable-ai-agent/src/core/agents.js:657-661)."
